title: The Longevity Imperative: Redefining the Way We Age

reader_summary.headline: You're keeping people alive, you're not keeping them healthy.
reader_summary.overview: You're keeping people alive, you're not keeping them healthy. The view that medicine starts with disease is part of the problem because it should start with health. One in five, one in six Brits are meant to live to 100 according to the government.

key_points.text: Is your 401K set for you to live to 100?
key_points.evidence_quote: Is your 401K set for you to live to 100?

key_points.text: And you can be 100, and literally running 100 meters, you can look at it on YouTube.
key_points.evidence_quote: And you can be 100, and literally running 100 meters, you can look at it on YouTube, or you can be 50 in a wheelchair.

key_points.text: Instead of this being a crisis, it could be the greatest accomplishment of humanity.
key_points.evidence_quote: Instead of this being a crisis, it could be the greatest accomplishment of humanity.
